features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description: At 1st level, choose one type of dragon as your ancestor (Black=Acid, Blue=Lightning, Brass=Fire, Bronze=Lightning, Copper=Acid, Gold=Fire, Green=Poison, Red=Fire, Silver=Cold, White=Cold). You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Charisma checks when interacting with dragons.

choices.name: Draconic Ancestry
choices.description: Choose your dragon ancestor's damage type.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: At 1st level, your HP maximum increases by 1 and by 1 again each time you gain a sorcerer level. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of your draconic ancestry type, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll. You can also spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout dragon wings from your back as a bonus action, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action. You can't manifest them while wearing incompatible armor.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, spend 5 sorcery points as an action to exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to 60 feet for 1 minute (concentration). Each hostile creature starting its turn in the aura makes WIS save or is charmed (awe) or frightened (fear) until the aura ends. Success = immune for 24 hours.
